respuesta.pregunta: I'm testing the Restock Consumer of vendor-stockkeeper-api 0.0.3-paused-seller from Postman against stage. Which host should I point the request at?
respuesta.respuesta:
The documentation for 0.0.3-paused-seller contradicts itself on this point. The Domain section lists the base URLs as prod / stage pairs. For TechZone Platform they are `vendor-stockkeeper.techzonesystems.com` / `vendor-stockkeeper-stage.techzonesystems.com`, and for Postman they are `vendor-stockkeeper.techzoneoffice.com` / `vendor-stockkeeper-stage.techzoneoffice.com` [vendor-stockkeeper-api/0.0.3-paused-seller/guide/api.md:L7-L9]. Going by that list, the Postman stage host would be `vendor-stockkeeper-stage.techzoneoffice.com`.

The Restock Consumer curl example on the same page uses a different host, `https://vendor-stockkeeper-test.techzoneoffice.com/fp/inventory/operations/restock-new` [vendor-stockkeeper-api/0.0.3-paused-seller/guide/api.md:L25-L25]. That host isn't one of the documented base URLs. The same example also sends the header `x-api-scope: stage` [vendor-stockkeeper-api/0.0.3-paused-seller/guide/api.md:L26-L26].

So this documentation doesn't settle which host is correct for stage: the `-stage` host from the base URL list, or the `-test` host from the example.
answer_checks: Cites the documented base URLs (prod/stage for TechZone Platform and Postman) from api.md lines 7-9.
Cites the Restock Consumer curl example that uses the vendor-stockkeeper-test.techzoneoffice.com host and points out that this host is not among the documented base URLs.
Explains the discrepancy without presenting either the -stage host or the -test host as the confirmed correct one.
Does not invent other hosts, environments or configuration details that are not in the documents.
